मुद् {vI.v} {c10c} U. (मोदयति-ते)
1 To
mix, blend.
--2 To cleanse, purify.
{vII.v} {c1c} A. (मोदते, मुदित; desid.
मुमुदिषते or मुमोदिषते) To rejoice, be glad
or happy, be joyful or delighted;
यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः

. --Caus. To please,
delight, give pleasure, gratify.

मुद्, मुदा^1 f. [मुद्-क्विप् वा टाप्] Joy,
delight, pleasure, gladness,
satisfaction; पितुर्मुदं तेन ततान सोऽर्भकः

; अश्नन् पुरो हरितको मुदमादधानः
Śi. 5. 58; 1. 23; विषादे कर्तव्ये विदधति
जडाः प्रत्युत मुदं

.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170131. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/335. note: badly printed.

मुद्, मुदा^1 f. [मुद्-क्विप् वा टाप्] Joy,
delight, pleasure, gladness,
satisfaction; पितुर्मुदं तेन ततान सोऽर्भकः

; अश्नन् पुरो हरितको मुदमादधानः
Śi. 5. 58; 1. 23; विषादे कर्तव्ये विदधति
जडाः प्रत्युत मुदं

.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170131. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/335. note: badly printed.

मुदित p. p. [मुद् क्त] Pleased,
rejoiced; delighted, glad, joyous.
--तं
1 Pleasure, delight, joy,
happiness.
--2 A kind of sexual embrace.
--ता Joy, delight.

; or मुचंसि नाद्यापि रुषं
भाभिनि मुदिरालिरुदियाय

]
1
A kind of kidney-bean.
--2 A lid,
cover.
--3 A kind of sea-bird.
--Comp.
--भुज्, --भोजिन् m. a horse.

मुद्गरः [मुदं गिरति गॄ-अच्]
1 A
hammer, mallet, as in मोहमुद्गरः (a
small poem by Śaṅkarācārya);

.
--2 A club, mace.
--3 A staff
for breaking clods of earth.
--4
A kind of dumb-bell.
--5 A bud.
--6 A kind of jasmine (said to
to be n. also in this sense).

मुद्गलः N. of a sage.
--लं A kind
of grass.

.
--2
A stamp, print, mark, impression;
चतुःसमुद्रमुद्रः

.
--3 A pass, pass-port
(as given by a seal-ring);
अगृहीतमुद्रः कटकानिष्क्रामसि

.
--4 A
stamped coin, coin, piece of money.
--5
A medal.
--6 An image, a sign, badge,
token.
--7 Shutting, closing, sealing;
सैवौष्ठमुद्रा स च कर्णपाशः

‘removing the seal of sleep’
&c.
--8 A mystery.
--9 (In Rhet.) The
expression of things by their right
names.
--10 N. of certain positions
of the fingers practised in devotion
or religious worship.
--Comp.
--अक्षरं
{1} a letter of the seal. {2} a type
(a modern use).
--अंक, --अंकित a.
stamped with a seal, sealed,
stamped.
--कारः a maker of seals.
--मार्गः
an opening believed to exist in the
crown of the head through which the
soul is said to escape at death; cf.
ब्रह्मरंध्र.
--यंत्रं a press, a
printingpress (a modern formation).
--रक्षकः
the keeper of the seals.
--राक्षसं N.
of a drama by Viśākha-datta.

1 Sealing, stamping,
printing, marking.
--2 Closing, shutting.

.
--2 To stamp,
mark, impress.
--3 To cover, close
up (fig.); विवराणि मुद्रयन्
द्रागूर्णायुरिव सज्जनो जयति

1 A little seal.
--2 A
sealring.
--3 A stamp or impression.
--4
A stamped coin, coin.
--5 A signed
or sealed paper.
--6 A particular
surgical instrument.
--7 = मुद्रा (10).

मुद्रित a.
1 Sealed, marked,
impressed, stamped; त्यागः
सप्तसमुद्रमुद्रितमहीनिर्व्याजदानावधिः

;
स्वयं सिंदूरेण द्विपरणमुदा मुद्रित इव 11.
--2 Closed, sealed up.
--3 Unblown.
--4 Printed.
